name: Citrus City Grille
tagline: Beloved neighborhood bistro with Mediterranean flair, craft martinis, and lively patio
description: An Old Towne culinary staple since 1996, Citrus City Grille offers contemporary California cuisine infused with Mediterranean soul. Famous for Chilean sea bass, braised lamb shank, homemade ravioli, and an active bar scene serving creative shaken martinis accompanied by weekend live jazz.
historicNote: Housed in an elegant 1920s commercial building in the heart of Old Towne, featuring French doors opening onto vibrant sidewalk bistro seating.

specials.title: Martini Monday
specials.description: $8 classic and specialty shaken martinis (Lemon Drop, Cosmopolitan, Espresso Martini) all evening.

specials.title: Mediterranean Flatbread & Wine Pair
specials.description: Artisan fig & prosciutto or Greek lamb flatbread + glass of house Cabernet for $19.

specials.title: Wine Down Wednesday
specials.description: 50% off all bottles of California and Italian reserve wines with the purchase of two dinner entrees.

specials.title: Prime Steak & Frites Night
specials.description: Certified Angus Prime Coulotte Steak with truffle parmesan frites and chimichurri for $29.

specials.title: Bistro Sunset Happy Hour
specials.description: $7 draft beers, $8 house wines, $9 calamari fritti, and $8 Mediterranean hummus dip.

specials.title: Weekend Champagne Brunch
specials.description: Eggs Benedict, Smoked Salmon Bagel Platter, French Toast, and bottomless champagne refills for $15.

specials.title: Sunday Family Pasta Feast
specials.description: Chef’s family-style pasta platters served with garlic bread and Caesar salad ($24 per person).

events.title: Live Patio Jazz Evenings
events.description: Enjoy smooth acoustic and jazz duos performing live on the outdoor garden patio under string lights.
